_readme: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored, so your API keys and household details never leave this machine.
_ebird: Free key, instant: https://ebird.org/api/keygen (or set the EBIRD_API_KEY environment variable instead).
_where: Center point and default radius of the board. dist_km is capped by eBird at 50 km; back_days 30 is eBird's max window.
_who: The household: id -> display name. Ids are lowercase slugs (they become data/life_<id>.json and settings values). Any number of people works; the UI builds itself from this list.
_credits: Name credited (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) on images you upload via the settings page.
_images: Only used by the OPTIONAL build_images.py pre-build step; the running app never calls an image service. Leave blank to use silhouettes or the free pollinations provider.
